text: Don't bother listening to what the opposition candidate says about healthcare reform. She's a wealthy trust fund baby who has never had to worry about paying a medical bill in her entire pampered life. How could someone who grew up with a silver spoon possibly understand what real families go through?

annotations.quote: She's a wealthy trust fund baby who has never had to worry about paying a medical bill in her entire pampered life.

metadata.note: Ad Hominem rephrased with different personal attack (wealth/privilege instead of academic background). Same structure: dismiss the argument by attacking the person's background.
